_about: Which source field feeds each benchmark_id (SPEC section 2; SPEC 5 Q7 keeps the vocabulary stable). Edit this file, not the code, to add or remap a benchmark. 'stored' is the path in sample_data/benchmark.json; 'artificial_analysis_api' is the path in GET /api/v2/data/llms/models (checked 2026-10-28) times 'scale', or null when the API doesn't publish it.
_missing: API values listed in a field's 'missing_values' mean 'not measured' and become gaps: the benchmark is left out, never stored as a score (team, 2026-10-30). Seen on 2026-10-28: 0 speeds and latencies (Kimi K3, Solar Pro 4), LCR 0.0 (Sarvam 105B), null intelligence index (5 models).

aa_omniscience_index.note: Not published by the API (SPEC section 2). Kept for SCENARIO_01 until SPEC 5 Q12 is decided; values come from the Artificial Analysis web pages.
